purpose: Uniform row suffix optimization: correctness validation, diagnostic profiling, decoder screening and paired Linux replication
optimization: Skip unchanged uniform row suffixes when clearing rows and skip known blank suffixes while finding retained content; all Cell fields participate in equality.
local_environment: Shared Apple M4 macOS host; Linux binaries run under Ubuntu 26.04 arm64 Docker/Colima and Weston headless pixman

decoder_screening.order: before/after on odd pairs; after/before on even pairs
decoder_screening.scope: Decoder only; no PTY, font atlas or renderer

profile.scope: Diagnostic macOS sample captured while running the baseline short-lines workload; benchmark interrupted after sampling and not counted as a completed throughput run

other_attempts.initial-candidate.txt: Unpaired 8 MiB candidate run with three samples; highly variable shared-host load
other_attempts.baseline-recheck.txt: Subsequent unpaired 8 MiB baseline sample; not a controlled pair with the first run

other_attempts.ci-invalid-build.json: Rejected for revision attribution: workflow34609339282 reused the baseline Cargo output for the candidate; report status passed only reflects metric/geometry checks, not valid source-to-binary provenance.

linux.x11_clipboard: Exact UTF-8, compound graphemes and wrapped URL after four resizes passed

limits: DSR acknowledges processing, not frame presentation or input-to-photon latency.
Throughput harness does not prove visual equivalence; correctness tests run separately.
Software rendering in a VM/CI runner does not establish superiority over Ghostty, Alacritty or Kitty on physical Omarchy/Hyprland.
